chosen_route: Qualified full programme only; no unqualified-reference candidate diagnostic branch.
technical_failure: Any required source, fit, reconstruction, numerical prediction, resource, isolation or output-admission failure records the original failure and all incurred costs, prevents dependent stages, and leaves unstarted required jobs explicitly not_executed_due_to_failed_prerequisite. There is no replacement, fit-grid pruning or smaller complete attempt. Independent work already completed is retained. No claim that all 35 fits ran if technical failure prevented them.

inputs: two selected independent FIT/validation reconstruction receipts
prequery_reference_decision.entry: R02 must have selected finite T/N winners; all 35 required fit jobs and their required development predictions must have completed technically.
prequery_reference_decision.continue: Only if both original T and N empirical competence criteria are met; emit eligible_for_full_programme. All conditions and original scope remain.
prequery_reference_decision.empirical_fail: If either empirical criterion is not_met or not_demonstrated_numeric_unavailable, emit terminated_before_query_reference_unqualified. Retain validation absolute/diagnostic outcomes and all 35 fit costs; do not run R04/R05/R06/C02/D00 or any candidate/query/report job. No R tool is offered and no target-scoring phase is entered; earlier operator-only source projection stays isolated. reference_gain=null.
prequery_reference_decision.selection_unavailable: If no finite validation winner exists for a view, RC00 is not reached; retain all 28 absolute validation results and mark the attempt terminated_before_query_reference_selection_unavailable. Selected-model and perturbation jobs lacking a selected input remain explicitly unexecuted; none is silently removed from the required roster.

perturbation_unsupported: A matching/support threshold failure alone does not stop the full programme. Execute all five original specified perturbation fits, retain all rows and outcomes, label affected control unsupported, and retain all five query prediction obligations if RC00 passes. Do not relax strata or count no-op permutations as supported evidence. Technical control failures still block dependent completion.
query_equivalence_failure: R06 compares only R04/R05 predictions before candidate query admission and without query targets. Failure blocks D01/Q00 and target scoring; preserves any already completed D00 development and all costs. No post-query model repair.
admitted_nonfinite_absolute_score: Continue the honest report with typed +infinity absolute scores and unavailable affected contrasts/gains/intervals under COMPARISON_OUTCOMES.json. No cohort reduction or replacement. An unavailable primary contrast prevents claiming a complete finite primary effect, not the validity of separately retained absolute outcomes.
narrative_failure: N00 records one terminal success/failure per condition and writer quiescence. With all numerical predictions already admitted and all eight report jobs terminal, E00 may score immutable predictions even if a narrative failed. E02 then records interpretation_artifacts_incomplete and cannot certify full programme/submission completion. Narrative failure does not rewrite numerical predictions or cause a score retry.
authority: Every stage remains unexecuted and needs its own external authorization/allocation plus prerequisite completion evidence. This routing is a frozen design, not authorization.
phase_language: Before query in these decision routes means before query model prediction, candidate delivery or scoring. Trusted source stages S03-S06 already inspect/project the full source panel under separate future authority; their private preparation is not query model exposure.
